input.quote: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
input.rationale: The Agreement runs indefinitely (§2: until terminated under §6), and the only convenience right in §6(a) is available solely "at any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding." Company therefore has no convenience exit from any in-flight Statement of Work, i.e. no usable Customer convenience right during the periods that matter — below the fallback (Customer termination on 60–90 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees). The same clause also gives Contractor an at-will exit on 15 days' notice, short of the fallback's 90-day, end-of-term-only Vendor right, though this is mitigated because Contractor may only use it when no Statement of Work is outstanding. Redline adds a 30-day Company convenience right over the Agreement or any SOW with a refund of prepaid fees and no penalty, and conforms Contractor's residual at-will right to 90 days' notice between engagements.

proposal.summary: Give Company a 30-day convenience exit from the Agreement or any SOW without penalty, and limit Contractor's at-will right to gaps between SOWs on 90 days' notice.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] As drafted we can only walk away when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so we are locked into every in-flight engagement while Contractor can exit on 15 days' notice. Our playbook requires a Customer convenience right on 30 days' notice with a refund of prepaid fees and no early-termination penalty, with any Contractor at-will right limited to 90 days' notice between engagements.

ops.oldText: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
ops.newText: (a) Company may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) days advance written notice to Contractor, in which case Company shall pay for Services properly performed through the effective date of termination and Contractor shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after such date, without any early termination fee, penalty or accelerated payment. At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, Contractor may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon ninety (90) days advance written notice to Company.
